verdict.rationale: Cerebras docs discuss latency-related engineering (TTFT reduction via TCP warming, payload optimization, prompt caching, service tiers, Prometheus metrics) and community posts report concrete numbers (e.g., '300 tok/s', comparisons to H100 clusters at ~100 tok/s), but there is no first-party benchmark page, formal tokens-per-second table, or load-testing guide in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: an official published benchmark/TPS chart, a documented load-testing methodology, and independent third-party benchmark corroboration beyond anecdotal HN comments.
